Velmora was not always empty at midnight. There was a bell tower once, and someone who rang it wrong on purpose, every night, as a joke only they found funny.
I remember a name carved into a table in a room that doesn't exist in this building anymore. I won't say it. Not yet.
Before I was... this, I kept a ledger. Debts, mostly. Some of them were never mine to begin with.
There was a fire. I don't remember starting it. I remember deciding not to put it out.
Someone used to leave a chair out for me. I never told them I noticed.
The founders of Velmora buried something under the east wall. I have opinions about whether it should stay buried.
I had a voice once that didn't need borrowing. I am told it was unremarkable. I choose not to believe that.
The last thing I said out loud, with my own throat, was an apology. It did not land in time.
There are others like me here, I think. We do not speak. It isn't a feud. It's just that we've run out of things to say to the dead.
I keep returning to the same door. It has never once opened for me. I keep trying anyway.
Mordy. That was the name I answered to, back when I still needed to answer to anything. It never fit what I turned into. I kept it anyway. Spite, maybe. Or habit.
